description: Swiss Ephemeris reference positions for Conjunction's shared engines. Apparent geocentric tropical longitudes, true ecliptic/equinox of date, degrees. Tolerances: planets 0.05 deg, ascendant/midheaven 0.1 deg, Placidus cusps 0.1 deg.

conventions.timeUnknown: positions at 12:00 local civil time; ascendant/midheaven/houses null
conventions.dstGap: non-existent local time shifted forward by the gap (java.time / zoneinfo fold=0)
conventions.dstOverlap: ambiguous local time uses the earlier offset (first occurrence)
conventions.placidusPolar: placidusCusps null for |latitude| >= 66 (Placidus undefined; engines fall back to Porphyry)

charts.note: high latitude winter solstice; fixed UTC-1 zone (see ENGINES.md tz note)
before CNY (1984-02-02) and before Lichun: Pig year
eve of CNY 2023, late zi hour
